title: [Main]- "Filter by Attribute" action does not apply the filter under specific circumstances
summary: The 'Filter by Attribute' action on the Item List page now preserves user-applied filters instead of replacing them, fixing cases where filters were incorrectly lost during attribute filtering.
key_points: Attribute filtering now uses a temporary record filtering flow consistently
User-applied filters (like Vendor No. conditions) are preserved and combined with attribute results
Page record context is no longer reset during attribute filtering
The fix applies across all regional versions of the Item List page
Added test coverage for attribute filtering scenarios
quote: Filter by Attributes action to always use the temp-record filtering flow and removed the reset of the page record context
